# Mind Control

- **Status:** 🔶 Partial
- **Skills affected:** Mind Control
- **Mechanic tags:** dot, damage-pool, channeled, methodology
- **Last verified:** 2026-07-10 by Tyra

## Setup

SS12. Skill level 16, no gear unless stated. Target: the standard Level-85 dummy (30% erosion resistance, 30% elemental resistance, 50% armor) — see [training-dummy](training-dummy.md). Mind Control is `Spell / Erosion / Channeled / Persistent`, base 222/sec Erosion Damage Over Time at L16, cast speed 0.333, no hit component whatsoever (a pure skill-DoT host). "Meter" = the in-game damage-recount readout (span average, not the tooltip).

## Raw data points

See [dot-model](dot-model.md) for the full twelve-parse sweep this skill contributes half of (baseline, +18% Skill Effect Duration, +9%/+27% increased, Control Spell, Shortened Duration ×2). Baseline L16: model 155.4 DPS vs meter 150.5 (+3.3% model error). Links (visual chains to the target) do NOT multiply single-target DPS — confirmed by the acceptance parse, which used the default link count with no change in per-target damage.

## Derived / confirmed formula

`dot_dps = 222/sec × (1 + Σ increased) × Π(1 + additional) × resist_only_mult`, resistance-only mitigation (armor excluded — see [dot-armor-exclusion](dot-armor-exclusion.md)) and no crit ([dot-no-crit](dot-no-crit.md)). Additional pool includes an intrinsic `+21.5% additional per additional Max Channeled Stack` above the base 5 (dormant at base — no measured data point exercises a 6th+ stack yet).

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Status `partial`, not `confirmed`: this entry inherits the dot-model.json residual (model runs ~0–6% off the meter depending on whether *increased* mods are present) — see that entry's `notes` for the full residual analysis, which is an open question, not resolved here. The channeled-stack additional (+21.5%/stack above base 5) is dormant in every recorded data point (base 5 stacks throughout) — its magnitude is taken from the support/skill text, not independently isolated by a >5-stack parse.

## Implementation (engine model)

`backend/engine/skill_resolver.py::_resolve_mind_control` (~L640) registers the skill via the shared `_resolve_dot_skill` (~L594, `base_text_key="damage"`, `damage_type="erosion"`): `hit_forms_by_level={}`, `is_spell=True`, `ChanneledSpec(max_stacks=5, behavior="refresh")`, `IntrinsicAdditional(per=0.215, rating_key="max_channeled_stacks_flat", rating_source="stat", per_n=1.0)`. **NYI, surfaced not wired:** Mind Control's link count (game text: 3 base links + 1 per additional channeled stack) is not modeled — the engine reports single-target DPS as if link count were irrelevant, which matches the measured acceptance data (links don't multiply single-target DPS) but does not model any link-count-scaled effect that might exist elsewhere (e.g. multi-target cleave). The two link-count-scaled supports, `mind_control_concentrate_magnificent` and `mind_control_enthrall_noble`, are NOT wired — they would need a numeric `mind_control_links` condition that doesn't exist yet. `befuddle` and `entice` (Mind Control's other canvas supports) gate on subsystems that don't exist in the engine yet and are also left NYI. None of this is modeled as "confirmed absent" — it is simply not built.
